name: LaEeb
fix_description: In swapTokensForEth, swap executed with insufficient slippage protection. Fix: set reasonable amountOutMin based on oracle price.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, direct exploit: flash-loan WBNB, swap into the vulnerable token, repeatedly abuse the pair via transfer+skim in a simple loop, then swap back and repay. It uses standard AMM/flash-loan primitives with minimal protocol-specific complexity, and the PoC is well under 100 lines.
